title.narrative: EU TUMO Convergence Center for Engineering and Applied Science

description.narrative: The project aims to (i) to strengthen the link between the academia and the IT/engineering industry, (ii) accelerate the transformation of Armenian higher education system, while (iii) providing shared research facilities and project based instruction open to all Armenian STEM students. To further strengthen the link between research and industry, the centre will offer incubator facilities to start-ups and small technology companies.
